visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a dimly lit, high-end restaurant at night with warm artificial lighting. A group of young adults is gathered around a table with food and drinks, laughing and gesturing energetically. (2) Scene shifts to a brightly lit, modern office during the day. Two men, Ian in a gray sweatshirt and glasses and another man in a white long-sleeved shirt, stand in a hallway discussing a piece of paper. (3) Close-up shots in the office show multiple hands placing small white paper slips into a white plastic bin. The background is a mix of glass partitions and office furniture. (4) Back at the restaurant at night, Ian, wearing a black sweatshirt with a large floral graphic, holds a cardboard box while speaking excitedly to the camera and his companions. (5) Intercut shots show a woman in a pink shirt in a bright kitchen-like office area, gesturing as she describes her wishlist items. (6) Ian presents the gift to Penny, who opens the box to reveal a 2026 planner. Her facial expression is one of genuine surprise and happiness. (7) The sequence repeats for several other participants. Annie, in a black jacket, receives a cream-colored scarf from Penny and immediately wraps it around her neck while smiling broadly. (8) Zora receives a bright yellow box containing a Kodak film camera from Annie, reacting with high-energy excitement and a wide grin. (9) Winnie opens a gift from Zora, which is a garment steamer; she laughs while holding the box. (10) Ian opens a brown paper bag from Winnie to find cotton pads, heat packs, and eye masks. He looks jokingly disappointed yet amused as he displays the items. (11) A final exchange occurs between Willy and Jeannie. Jeannie receives a green boxed figure related to the movie 'Wicked', and they both laugh heartily. (12) The video concludes with the whole group cheering and waving at the camera in the restaurant setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy mix of electronic pop background music and a chorus of excited laughter from multiple female and male voices. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the first transition. (2) Vocal narration is introduced at a fast pace as a male voice explains the gift exchange rules, accompanied by the rustling of paper and faint office ambient hum. (3) A sequence of rapid 'whoosh' and 'ping' sound effects occurs as the video cuts between speakers. High-pitched female vocals dominate as they list gift clues with a playful, teasing intonation. (4) The reveal phase features loud 'ding' sound effects and spontaneous cheering. The BGM remains upbeat, maintaining a driving 4/4 rhythm. (5) During the 'bad gift' reveals, comic 'boing' or 'wah-wah' sound effects are used to emphasize humorous disappointment, followed by explosive group laughter. (6) The video concludes with a collective vocal wave of goodbyes and festive greetings over a swelling music finale.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain and engage an audience by documenting a high-spirited office 'Secret Santa' gift exchange. The video focuses on the humorous contrast between the participants' specific wishlists and the actual gifts received, using fast-paced editing and variety-show style graphics to highlight emotional reactions.
